name: sol-advisor-work
description: Quality-first ChatGPT Work orchestration led by Sol with capability-aware delegation and verification.

interface.shortDescription: Quality-first Sol orchestration that adapts to the Work capabilities actually exposed.
interface.longDescription: Sol owns intent, architecture, verification, and acceptance. Exact Luna/Terra/Sol worker routing is used only when Work exposes verifiable controls. Otherwise the workflow safely uses role-based Work agents or a parent-only fallback without making unsupported model or isolation claims.
defaultPrompt: Use $orchestration. Check Work capabilities first, then choose the safest quality-first route.
Use parallel readers, one writer, parent verification, and risk-gated independent review.
